assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to evaluate arrhythmic triggers.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Diagnosis codes Z86.73 and I47.1 support the transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction history.
Prolonged rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmic triggers and assess stroke risk.
The prior authorization (CO-197) is denied for lack of precertification.
Advance approval is required to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
